projects.title: Brazilian E-commerce Analytics Dashboard
projects.description: Executive Power BI dashboard using the Brazilian Olist E-commerce dataset with multi-table relational model.
projects.shortDescription: Built an executive Power BI dashboard using the Brazilian Olist E-commerce dataset.
projects.businessProblem: Olist, a Brazilian e-commerce platform, needed comprehensive visibility into customer behavior, sales performance, and product analytics across multiple business dimensions to drive strategic decisions.
projects.objective: Build an executive-level interactive dashboard that provides real-time insights into sales trends, customer segmentation, product performance, and regional analysis.
projects.dataset: Brazilian Olist E-commerce Public Dataset containing 100k+ orders, customer data, product catalog, seller information, and geolocation data across Brazil.
projects.dataModeling: Designed a star schema with fact orders table connected to dimension tables for customers, products, sellers, and time intelligence.
insights: Top 3 product categories contribute to 60% of total revenue
São Paulo region accounts for 42% of all orders
Weekend orders have 25% higher average value than weekday orders
Free shipping increases conversion rate by 35%
Seller concentration: Top 5% sellers generate 40% of revenue
recommendations: Increase marketing budget in high-performing categories during weekends
Expand seller onboarding in underperforming regions
Implement loyalty program to improve repeat purchase rate
Optimize delivery logistics in Northeast region
Consider free shipping threshold to boost average order value
projects.challenges: Data cleaning required handling missing geolocation data and inconsistent product categorization. Performance optimization needed for real-time filtering across 100k+ records.
projects.outcome: Delivered a production-ready dashboard adopted by the executive team, reducing monthly reporting time by 70% and enabling data-driven decision making.

projects.title: Employee Attrition & HR Analytics Dashboard
projects.description: Interactive Power BI dashboard analyzing employee attrition, workforce demographics, and key retention factors using the IBM HR Analytics dataset.
projects.shortDescription: Built a two-page HR Analytics dashboard to identify employee turnover trends and retention insights.
projects.businessProblem: Employee turnover is one of the biggest challenges for organizations, leading to increased recruitment costs, productivity loss, and reduced employee morale. HR managers require a centralized reporting solution to identify the factors influencing employee attrition and improve workforce retention.
projects.objective: Develop an interactive HR Analytics dashboard that enables decision-makers to monitor employee attrition, analyze workforce demographics, identify high-risk employee groups, and understand the key drivers behind employee turnover.
projects.dataset: IBM HR Analytics Employee Attrition & Performance Dataset containing employee demographics, job roles, salaries, performance metrics, work-life balance, overtime, promotions, and attrition information.
projects.dataModeling: Imported and transformed HR data using Power Query, created calculated measures with DAX, and designed an interactive data model supporting cross-filtering and drill-down analysis across multiple HR dimensions.
insights: Research & Development department recorded the highest number of employee exits.
Employees working overtime showed a noticeably higher attrition rate.
Most resignations occurred among employees with fewer years at the company.
Lower job satisfaction and poor work-life balance were associated with higher employee turnover.
Sales Executives and Laboratory Technicians experienced relatively high attrition compared to other job roles.
recommendations: Reduce excessive overtime through improved workforce planning.
Strengthen employee engagement and satisfaction programs.
Review promotion and career development opportunities for long-term employees.
Provide targeted retention strategies for high-risk departments and job roles.
Monitor HR KPIs regularly using interactive dashboards to support proactive decision-making.
projects.challenges: Designed a dashboard that clearly communicates workforce trends while balancing multiple HR metrics across two report pages. Created DAX measures and interactive visuals to present meaningful business insights without overwhelming end users.
projects.outcome: Delivered a professional two-page HR Analytics dashboard that transforms raw employee data into actionable insights through interactive KPIs, trend analysis, and executive-level reporting.
